method: Public documentation pages of the provider were read without signing in, without any account action and without any project, through an automated page reader that summarises the page for a stated question. Nothing was bought, created, requested or changed. The figures are what the pages said on the retrieval date; the pages themselves say pricing may change, so the owner re-confirms on the live pages at the moment of PG4 (the test cannot do that: it checks only that every figure used by the D-3 document is traceable to an entry here).
